guildIdLinkHint: Paste Discord channel URL to auto-extract server ID
chDescTelegram: Simplest way to get started — register a bot with @BotFather

chDescMatrix: Open protocol; configure a homeserver + access token

tipWeixinName: Optional display name for this WeChat account
tipWeixinCdnUrl: WeChat CDN base URL for media files
tipWeixinRouteTag: Optional route tag for request routing
tipDmPolicy: Controls DM access: pairing requires verification; open allows everyone; allowlist restricts to listed users
tipGroupPolicy: Controls group access: allowlist responds to specified groups; open responds to all; disabled ignores groups
tipAllowFrom: List of user IDs or usernames allowed to interact with the bot
tipBotToken: Bot token from the platform for API authentication
tipWebhookUrl: Webhook callback URL for receiving messages (optional, uses polling if empty)
tipFeishuDomain: Choose Feishu (China) or Lark (International), or enter a custom domain
tipFeishuConn: WebSocket is more stable; Webhook requires a public URL
tipVoiceProvider: Voice provider: Twilio/Telnyx for production, Mock for dev/testing
tipDiscordToken: Discord bot token (from Discord Developer Portal)
tipGuildIds: Discord server ID list. How to find: open Discord channel in browser, URL format is discord.com/channels/ServerID/ChannelID, the first number is the Server ID (only enter Server ID, not Channel ID)
tipMaxLines: Max lines per message, auto-splits if exceeded
tipSlackBot: Slack Bot Token (from Slack App settings)
tipSlackMode: Socket Mode needs no public URL; HTTP mode requires webhook setup
tipSlackBots: Allow bot-authored messages to trigger replies
tipSignalReceive: Message receive method: HTTP is most common
tipGCServiceAccount: Google Cloud service account JSON path
tipTeamsTenant: Azure AD Tenant ID (required for single-tenant)
tipMMToken: From Mattermost System Console → Integrations → Bot Accounts
tipMMChatMode: How the bot is triggered in channels
tipFeishuWebhookPath: Webhook route path for event callbacks (default /feishu/events)
tipFeishuAllowFrom: List of Feishu user Open IDs (ou_xxx) allowed to DM the bot
tipFeishuGroupAllowFrom: List of Feishu group chat IDs (oc_xxx) the bot responds to
tipFeishuRequireMention: Require @mention in group chats for the bot to respond (default on)
tipFeishuStreaming: Enable streaming card output — bot updates a card incrementally as it generates (default on)
tipFeishuRenderMode: Message render mode: auto detects markdown; raw sends plain text; card always uses interactive cards
tipFeishuReplyInThread: Reply in topic threads: disabled sends inline replies; enabled creates Feishu topic threads
tipFeishuTypingIndicator: Show typing reaction while generating a reply (disable to reduce API calls)
tipFeishuResolveSenderNames: Resolve sender display names from Feishu profile (disable to reduce API calls)
tipFeishuGroupSessionScope: Session isolation for groups: per group, per group+sender, per topic thread, or per topic+sender
tipFeishuReactionNotifications: Reaction notifications: off disables; own notifies on own messages; all notifies on all
tipFeishuTextChunkLimit: Max characters per outbound message chunk (default 2000)
tipFeishuMediaMaxMb: Max media file size in MB for upload/download (default 30)
tipFeishuToolChat: Enable chat info and member query tools
tipFeishuToolPerm: Enable permission management tools (sensitive, default off)
feishuAccInheritHint: Other settings (policies, tools, streaming, etc.) inherit from the top-level config unless overridden.
tipFeishuAccName: Display name for this account (UI only)
tipWecomCorpId: WeCom Corp ID (found at the bottom of My Enterprise page)
tipWecomAes: Callback EncodingAESKey (43 characters, must match WeCom console)
tipWecomWebhookPath: Callback path, must match the URL path configured in WeCom console (default /wecom)
tipWecomMention: Whether @mention is required in group chats
tipWecomBotId: WeCom smart bot Bot ID (auto-generated when creating bot)
tipWecomBotSecret: WeCom smart bot Secret (auto-generated when creating bot)
tipWecomConn: Long connection mode requires no public IP (recommended); Webhook mode needs public callback URL
tipWecomAppWebhookPath: Callback path, must match the URL in WeCom Receive Messages setting (default /wecom-app)
tipWecomAppSecret: Self-built app Secret (from app details page)
tipQQAppId: QQ Bot AppID (from QQ Open Platform)
tipQQClientSecret: QQ Bot AppSecret (from app details page)
tipQQClientSecretFile: Path to a file containing the client secret (alternative to inline secret)
tipQQMarkdown: Enable Markdown rendering (requires separate Markdown template permission)
tipQQAllowFrom: Allowed sender IDs (e.g. qqbot:user-xxx). Leave empty to allow all.
tipQQSystemPrompt: Override system prompt for this QQ Bot channel
tipQQUrlDirectUpload: Upload media files directly via URL instead of downloading first
tipQQUpgradeUrl: Custom upgrade URL for the QQ Bot plugin
tipQQUpgradeMode: Upgrade mode: doc (documentation) or hot-reload (live reload)
tipQQVoiceDirectFormats: Audio formats that can be sent directly without transcoding
tipQQSttDirectFormats: Audio formats that STT accepts directly without conversion
tipQQUploadDirectFormats: Audio formats that can be uploaded directly
tipQQTranscodeEnabled: Enable audio transcoding for unsupported formats
tipQQSttProvider: STT provider ID (matches a configured model provider)
tipQQSttBaseUrl: Custom API base URL for STT provider
tipQQSttApiKey: API key for STT provider (overrides provider default)
tipQQTtsProvider: TTS provider ID (matches a configured model provider)
tipQQTtsBaseUrl: Custom API base URL for TTS provider
tipQQTtsApiKey: API key for TTS provider (overrides provider default)
tipQQTtsVoice: Voice name for TTS (e.g. alloy, echo, fable)
tipQQTtsAuthStyle: Authentication style: Bearer token or API-Key header
tipQQName: Optional display name for this QQ Bot account
tipQQStreaming: Block streaming mode: partial (incremental delivery) or off (buffer full response)
tipQQTtsQueryParams: Additional query parameters for TTS API requests
tipYuanbaoAppSecret: Yuanbao Party AppSecret (from Yuanbao App linking page)
tipDTClientId: DingTalk Client ID (AppKey, from credentials page)
tipDTAICard: Enable AI Card streaming (requires Card.Instance.Write and Card.Streaming.Write permissions)
tipDTMention: Whether @mention is required in group chats
tipVoiceFrom: Phone number used for outbound calls
tipSelfChat: Allow interacting with the bot by messaging yourself
tipDebounce: Merge messages within this window to avoid duplicate replies
tipTypingReaction: Emoji reaction shown while AI is processing (e.g. hourglass_flowing_sand). Leave empty to disable
ownerAllowFromDesc: IDs allowed to run owner commands
talkModeDesc: Choose how to interact with the Agent using voice
browserRequestDesc: Send a request through the Gateway browser proxy
costHint: Leave empty to use default pricing
budgetDailyHint: Daily spending limit, set to 0 for unlimited
budgetMonthlyHint: Monthly spending limit, set to 0 for unlimited
budgetThresholdHint: Show warning when reaching this percentage
tipDmTopics: Enable forum-style topics in DM conversations
tipDisableAudioPreflight: Skip audio preflight check before sending voice messages
tipReplyToMode: Reply-to-thread mode (off=disabled, first=first message only, all=all messages)
tipHistoryLimit: Max group/channel messages to keep as history (0 disables)
tipDmHistoryLimit: Max DM turns to keep as history
tipTextChunkLimit: Outbound text chunk size in characters
tipChunkMode: Chunking method: by length or by newline
tipMediaMaxMb: Max outbound media file size in MB
tipResponsePrefix: Outbound response prefix override (empty string disables global prefix)
tipAckReaction: Emoji reaction sent on message receipt (e.g. 👀)
tipLinkPreview: Show link previews in outbound messages
tipSendReadReceipts: Send read receipts on message receipt
tipAllowBots: Bot message handling: Off = ignore all bots; On = respond to all bot messages; Mentions Only = only respond when mentioned by a bot
tipImsgRemoteHost: Remote SSH host for SCP attachment fetching
tipImsgAttachments: Include attachments and reactions in message payload
tipSlackSigningSecret: Slack signing secret (required for HTTP mode)
tipSlackMention: Require @bot mention in channels to respond
tipGCServiceAccountFile: Google Chat service account JSON file path
tipGCAudience: Audience value (app URL or project number)
tipGCMention: Require @bot mention in spaces to respond
tipTeamsMention: Require @bot mention in channels/groups to respond
tipTeamsReplyStyle: Reply style: thread reply or top-level new message
tipTeamsSharePoint: SharePoint site ID for file uploads
tipDiscordIntentPresence: Must be enabled in Discord Developer Portal
tipDiscordIntentMembers: Must be enabled in Discord Developer Portal
tipPublicUrl: Public webhook URL override (bypasses tunnel auto-detection)
tipCallMode: Outbound mode (notify=hangup after message, conversation=stay open)
tipTelnyxPublicKey: Telnyx webhook signature verification public key
tipYuanbaoAppKey: Yuanbao Party App ID (from Yuanbao App linking page)
saveCredentialMissing: Required channel credentials missing — please fill in before saving
wizWarnDmAllowlistEmpty: DM policy is "Allowlist" but Allow From is empty — all DMs will be silently dropped
wizWarnGroupAllowlistEmpty: Group policy is "Allowlist" but Allow From / Group Allow From are both empty — all group messages will be silently dropped
mcpServersDesc: Named MCP server definitions. Each key is a server name with command, args, and env fields.
askFallbackDesc: Fallback policy when approval times out
safeBinTrustedDirsDesc: Directories where safe binaries are trusted
tipPairingCode: Enter the pairing code from the channel
contextTokensDesc: Maximum context window token cap for this agent. When conversation history exceeds this limit, compaction is triggered automatically. Leave empty to use the model's native context window.
localModelLeanDesc: Drop heavyweight default tools (browser, cron, message) to reduce prompt size for weaker local models.
gpt5PersonalityDesc: Enable the GPT-5 friendly-style prompt overlay globally. Falls back to the OpenAI plugin setting when unset.
unknownToolThresholdDesc: Stop hallucinated tool loops after N unknown-tool stream attempts (default 10; stream guard is on by default).
tipFeishuDomainCustom: Full HTTPS base URL for a private Feishu/Lark deployment
tipFeishuGroupSenderAllowFrom: In group_sender scope, only these sender open_ids can interact with the bot
tipFeishuHistoryLimit: Number of history messages loaded into context (0 = disabled)
tipFeishuDmHistoryLimit: DM history limit; inherits historyLimit when unset
tipFeishuChunkMode: length: split by character count; newline: split at newlines
tipFeishuHttpTimeout: Feishu API request timeout in milliseconds (max 300000)
tipFeishuHeartbeat: Controls the typing heartbeat visibility and refresh interval
tipFeishuCoalesce: Coalesce streaming updates to reduce card API call frequency
tipFeishuMarkdown: Controls how Markdown syntax and tables are rendered
tipFeishuConfigWrites: Allow the plugin to write back to openclaw.json
tipFeishuActionsReactions: Enable reaction buttons for bot messages
tipFeishuDynamicAgent: Automatically create a dedicated agent workspace per DM user
tipQQGroupPolicy: Group chat access policy. allowlist requires groupAllowFrom entries.
qqC2cStreamApiDesc: OpenClaw 2026.4.27+: use the official QQ C2C stream_messages API for true incremental streaming. Falls back to block streaming if disabled.
tipQQC2cStreamApi: Toggles QQ C2C stream_messages over block streaming.
tipYbName: Friendly bot label shown in logs and pairing prompts.
tipYbDmPolicy: Yuanbao DM access policy. Default open.
tipYbAllowFrom: Yuanbao user IDs allowed to DM the bot when policy is allowlist.
ybRequireMentionDesc: Default true. Set false to respond without @mention. Replying to bot is treated as implicit mention.
tipYbRequireMention: Whether the bot needs an @mention in group chats.
tipYbHistoryLimit: Group chat history entries included in AI context. 0 disables.
tipYbReplyToMode: How the bot quotes messages: off / first / all.
tipYbOutboundQueueStrategy: merge-text buffers chunks; immediate sends each chunk right away.
tipYbMinChars: Buffer until this many chars are queued.
tipYbMaxChars: Force-split outbound messages above this limit.
tipYbIdleMs: Auto-flush merge buffer after this idle timeout.
ybDisableBlockStreamingDesc: When true, sends the complete reply in one message instead of block streaming.
tipYbOverflowPolicy: Behavior when a message exceeds maxChars: split or stop.
tipYbFallbackReply: Reply text when the AI returns no content.
ybMarkdownHintEnabledDesc: Inject system prompt instructions to prevent the model from wrapping the entire reply in a code block.
tipYbMarkdownHintEnabled: Toggle markdown anti-wrapping system prompt hint.

migration.title: Claude / Hermes Migration
migration.subtitle: Import Claude (CLAUDE.md / MCP / skills / commands) or HermesAgent (config / providers / MCP / memory / skills) into OpenClaw.
migration.noProvidersHint: OpenClaw CLI reports no migration providers. Ensure openclaw 2026.4.26+ is installed.
migration.fromHint: Leave empty to use the provider default
migration.includeSecretsDesc: Hermes only imports recognized .env API keys (OPENAI_API_KEY, etc). Claude never imports credentials.
migration.overwriteDesc: Allow apply to overwrite when the plan reports conflicts. Apply still writes item-level backups first.
migration.noBackupDesc: Apply normally writes a verified backup first. Only check this on a fresh machine or when you have backed up yourself.
migration.confirmApply: I have reviewed the plan and want to apply
migration.confirmApplyDesc: Apply runs `openclaw migrate apply <provider> --yes` and creates a verified backup by default.
migration.conflictsHint: Conflicts present — go back and check --overwrite if you intend to overwrite.
migration.applyingDesc: Writing backup, applying state, archiving unsupported items. May take up to 4 minutes.

visibleRepliesDesc: Require visible output to go through message(action=send)
groupVisibleRepliesDesc: Override visible replies for group/channel chats
commitmentsDesc: Automatic inferred follow-up commitments with heartbeat delivery

remoteMigration.subtitle: Import OpenClaw config and agent files from a remote instance.
remoteMigration.modeClawDeckXDesc: Connect to another ClawDeckX instance and import its OpenClaw snapshot.
remoteMigration.modeGatewayDesc: Connect directly to a remote OpenClaw Gateway via WebSocket and import config + agent files.
remoteMigration.gwHostHint: IP or hostname of remote OpenClaw gateway
remoteMigration.passwordHint: Min 6 characters. Used to encrypt the imported snapshot.
remoteMigration.noteHint: Optional label for the imported snapshot
remoteMigration.importOk: Remote import succeeded — go to Snapshots to restore
remoteMigration.importOkHint: The remote config has been imported as a local snapshot. Go to the Snapshots tab to preview and selectively restore.
remoteMigration.modeFileDesc: Directly import a .clawbak backup file exported from another ClawDeckX instance.
remoteMigration.fileHint: Select a .clawbak file exported from another ClawDeckX
remoteMigration.fileImportOk: Backup file imported — go to Snapshots to restore
